2CH.P.4.1-5.text: The Bronze Altar and Molten Sea

2CH.P.4.6-8.text: The Ten Basins, Lampstands, and Tables

2CH.P.11.13-17.text: Jeroboam Forsakes the Priests and Levites

2CH.P.16.11-14.text: The Death and Burial of Asa

2CH.P.22.8-9.text: Jehu Kills the Princes of Judah

2CH.P.23.16-21.text: Jehoiada Restores the Worship of the LORD

2CH.P.34.14-21.text: Hilkiah Finds the Book of the Law

2CH.1.1-1.text: The LORD was with Solomon and made his kingdom strong

2CH.1.2-5.text: Solomon and Israel’s leaders go to worship at Gibeon

2CH.1.6-7.text: Solomon offers sacrifices, and God tells him to ask

2CH.1.8-11.text: Solomon asks God for wisdom to lead the people

2CH.1.12-13.text: God gives Solomon wisdom, riches and honor

2CH.2.1-3.text: Solomon plans the temple and asks King Hiram for cedar

2CH.2.4-5.text: Solomon tells Hiram why he will build a great temple

2CH.2.6-7.text: Solomon asks Hiram to send a skilled craftsman

2CH.2.8-10.text: Solomon asks for timber and promises food to the woodcutters

2CH.2.11-12.text: Hiram praises the LORD for giving Israel a wise king

2CH.2.13-14.text: Hiram sends Huram-abi, a skilled craftsman, to Solomon

2CH.2.15-18.text: Hiram will send logs, and Solomon puts foreigners to work

2CH.3.1-3.text: Solomon begins to build the temple in Jerusalem

2CH.3.4-4.text: Solomon builds the front portico and covers it with gold

2CH.3.5-5.text: Solomon covers the main room with cypress and gold

2CH.3.6-7.text: Solomon decorates the temple with stones, gold and cherubim

2CH.3.8-9.text: Solomon makes the Most Holy Place and covers it with gold

2CH.3.10-12.text: Solomon makes two gold cherubim with wide wings

2CH.3.13-13.text: The cherubim stand facing the main room

2CH.4.1-3.text: Solomon makes the bronze altar and the large Sea

2CH.4.4-5.text: The Sea stands on twelve bronze oxen

2CH.4.6-6.text: Solomon makes ten basins for washing offerings

2CH.4.7-8.text: Solomon makes gold lampstands, tables and bowls for the temple

2CH.4.11-13.text: Huram finishes the pots, pillars and other bronze work

2CH.4.14-16.text: Huram-abi makes the stands, basins and other bronze objects

2CH.4.17-18.text: Solomon casts the bronze objects in great amounts

2CH.5.1-1.text: Solomon finishes the temple and stores David’s gifts

2CH.5.2-3.text: Solomon gathers Israel’s leaders to bring up the ark

2CH.5.4-6.text: The Levites carry the ark, and the people offer many sacrifices

2CH.5.7-8.text: The priests place the ark in the Most Holy Place

2CH.5.9-10.text: The ark holds only the two tablets of Moses

2CH.5.11-14.text: The singers praise the LORD, and his glory fills the temple

2CH.6.1-3.text: Solomon speaks about the temple and blesses the people

2CH.6.4-6.text: Solomon praises the LORD for keeping his word to David

2CH.6.7-9.text: Solomon says David’s son, not David, will build the temple

2CH.6.10-11.text: Solomon says the LORD kept his promise to David

2CH.6.12-13.text: Solomon kneels on a bronze platform before the people

2CH.6.14-15.text: Solomon praises God for keeping his promise to David

2CH.6.16-17.text: Solomon asks God to keep his promise about David’s throne

2CH.6.18-20.text: Solomon asks God to hear prayers made toward the temple

2CH.6.21-21.text: Solomon asks God to hear and forgive Israel

2CH.6.22-23.text: Solomon asks God to judge oaths made at the altar

2CH.6.24-25.text: Solomon asks God to forgive Israel after defeat by enemies

2CH.6.26-27.text: Solomon asks God to send rain when Israel turns from sin

2CH.6.28-31.text: Solomon asks God to hear prayers in famine and plague

2CH.6.32-33.text: Solomon asks God to hear foreigners who pray at the temple

2CH.6.34-35.text: Solomon asks God to help Israel in war

2CH.6.36-42.text: Solomon asks God to forgive captive Israel who repent

2CH.7.4-6.text: Solomon and Israel offer sacrifices to dedicate the temple

2CH.7.7-7.text: Solomon offers sacrifices in the middle of the courtyard

2CH.7.8-10.text: Israel keeps a feast for seven days and goes home glad

2CH.7.11-12.text: The LORD tells Solomon he has chosen the temple

2CH.7.13-15.text: The LORD will forgive his people who pray and repent

2CH.7.16-18.text: The LORD promises Solomon a lasting throne if he obeys

2CH.7.19-22.text: The LORD warns of disaster if Israel serves other gods

2CH.8.1-2.text: Solomon rebuilds Hiram’s cities and settles Israelites

2CH.8.3-4.text: Solomon captures Hamath-zobah and builds Tadmor

2CH.8.5-6.text: Solomon builds fortified cities and store cities

2CH.8.7-8.text: Solomon forces the remaining peoples of the land to work

2CH.8.9-10.text: Solomon does not make Israelites work as slaves

2CH.8.11-11.text: Solomon moves Pharaoh’s daughter to her own palace

2CH.8.12-13.text: Solomon offers sacrifices as Moses commanded

2CH.8.14-15.text: Solomon appoints priests, Levites and gatekeepers

2CH.8.16-18.text: Solomon finishes the temple and gets gold from Ophir

2CH.9.1-2.text: The queen of Sheba tests Solomon with hard questions

2CH.9.3-4.text: The queen of Sheba is amazed by Solomon’s wisdom and palace

2CH.9.5-6.text: The queen says the report about Solomon is true

2CH.9.7-8.text: The queen blesses Solomon’s servants and praises the LORD

2CH.9.9-9.text: The queen of Sheba gives Solomon gold, spices and stones

2CH.9.10-12.text: Solomon gives the queen all she asks and she returns home

2CH.9.13-14.text: Solomon receives much gold each year

2CH.9.15-16.text: Solomon makes large and small gold shields

2CH.9.17-18.text: Solomon makes a great ivory throne covered with gold

2CH.9.19-21.text: Solomon’s throne has twelve lions and his cups are gold

2CH.9.22-24.text: Kings come to hear Solomon’s wisdom and bring gifts

2CH.9.25-26.text: Solomon has many horses and rules many kings

2CH.9.27-28.text: Silver is common in Jerusalem and horses come from Egypt

2CH.10.1-2.text: Rehoboam goes to Shechem and Jeroboam returns from Egypt

2CH.10.3-5.text: Israel asks Rehoboam for lighter work and waits three days

2CH.10.6-7.text: Rehoboam asks the elders, who advise him to be kind

2CH.10.8-9.text: Rehoboam rejects the elders and asks the young men

2CH.10.10-11.text: The young men advise Rehoboam to be harsh with the people

2CH.10.12-14.text: Rehoboam answers Israel harshly as the young men advised

2CH.10.15-15.text: Rehoboam does not listen, as God said through Ahijah

2CH.11.1-1.text: Rehoboam gathers 180,000 warriors to fight Israel

2CH.11.2-4.text: God tells Rehoboam through Shemaiah not to fight Israel

2CH.11.5-10.text: Rehoboam builds up fifteen cities for defense in Judah

2CH.11.11-12.text: Rehoboam puts officers and supplies in the fortresses

2CH.11.13-15.text: Priests and Levites leave Israel for Judah and Jerusalem

2CH.11.16-17.text: People from every tribe follow the Levites to Jerusalem

2CH.11.18-19.text: Rehoboam marries Mahalath and has three sons

2CH.11.20-21.text: Rehoboam marries Maacah, whom he loves most of all

2CH.11.22-23.text: Rehoboam makes Abijah chief prince and places his sons

2CH.12.1-1.text: Rehoboam and Israel forsake the Law of the LORD

2CH.12.2-4.text: Shishak of Egypt attacks Judah and reaches Jerusalem

2CH.12.5-6.text: Shemaiah warns Rehoboam; the leaders humble themselves

2CH.12.7-8.text: God promises to save Judah, but Judah will serve Shishak

2CH.12.9-10.text: Shishak takes the treasures; Rehoboam makes bronze shields

2CH.12.11-12.text: God’s anger turns from Rehoboam because he humbled himself

2CH.13.4-5.text: Abijah says God gave the kingdom to David’s family

2CH.13.6-7.text: Abijah says Jeroboam rebelled against Solomon

2CH.13.8-9.text: Abijah says Israel trusts golden calves and false priests

2CH.13.10-11.text: Abijah says Judah has not forsaken the LORD

2CH.13.12-12.text: Abijah warns Israel not to fight against the LORD

2CH.13.13-15.text: Judah cries to the LORD, and God defeats Jeroboam’s army

2CH.13.16-22.text: Judah defeats Israel because they trusted the LORD

2CH.14.1-4.text: Asa becomes king and removes foreign altars

2CH.14.5-6.text: Asa removes more altars and builds strong cities

2CH.14.7-8.text: Asa tells the people of Judah to build walls and towers

2CH.14.9-11.text: Asa prays to the LORD when Zerah attacks

2CH.14.12-15.text: The LORD defeats the Cushites and Judah takes plunder

2CH.15.1-2.text: Azariah tells Asa to seek the LORD

2CH.15.3-5.text: Azariah reminds Asa of Israel’s past without God

2CH.15.6-7.text: Azariah urges Asa and Judah to be strong

2CH.15.8-9.text: Asa removes idols and restores the LORD’s altar

2CH.15.10-11.text: The people gather in Jerusalem and offer sacrifices

2CH.15.12-13.text: The people make a covenant to seek the LORD

2CH.15.14-15.text: The people swear an oath and the LORD gives rest

2CH.15.16-19.text: Asa removes his grandmother Maacah as queen mother

2CH.16.1-1.text: Baasha of Israel fortifies Ramah against Judah

2CH.16.2-3.text: Asa sends silver and gold to Ben-hadad of Aram

2CH.16.4-6.text: Ben-hadad attacks Israel and Asa takes Ramah’s stones

2CH.16.7-8.text: Hanani tells Asa he trusted Aram, not the LORD

2CH.16.9-10.text: Hanani warns Asa of war, and Asa imprisons him

2CH.16.11-12.text: Asa has a foot disease and seeks only doctors

2CH.16.13-14.text: Asa dies and is buried in the City of David

2CH.17.1-2.text: Jehoshaphat becomes king and strengthens Judah’s cities

2CH.17.3-4.text: The LORD is with Jehoshaphat because he seeks God

2CH.17.5-6.text: Jehoshaphat becomes rich and removes high places

2CH.17.7-9.text: Jehoshaphat sends officials and Levites to teach the law

2CH.17.10-11.text: Fear of the LORD keeps nations from attacking Judah

2CH.17.12-13.text: Jehoshaphat grows stronger and builds fortresses

2CH.17.14-19.text: The commanders and soldiers who served Jehoshaphat

2CH.18.4-5.text: Four hundred prophets tell the kings to go to war

2CH.18.6-8.text: Jehoshaphat asks for another prophet, Micaiah

2CH.18.9-11.text: The prophets tell Ahab and Jehoshaphat to win the war

2CH.18.12-14.text: Micaiah is told to agree with the other prophets

2CH.18.15-16.text: Micaiah tells of Israel scattered like sheep

2CH.18.17-18.text: Ahab complains and Micaiah tells of his vision of the LORD

2CH.18.19-19.text: The LORD asks who will entice Ahab to go to battle

2CH.18.20-21.text: A spirit offers to lie through Ahab’s prophets

2CH.18.22-22.text: Micaiah says the LORD put a lying spirit in the prophets

2CH.18.23-24.text: Zedekiah strikes Micaiah, who warns of a day to hide

2CH.18.25-27.text: Ahab orders Micaiah put in prison until he returns

2CH.18.28-30.text: Ahab disguises himself, but Jehoshaphat wears royal robes

2CH.18.31-32.text: God helps Jehoshaphat when chariot commanders chase him

2CH.18.33-34.text: An arrow hits Ahab and he dies at sunset

2CH.19.4-5.text: Jehoshaphat appoints judges in the cities of Judah

2CH.19.6-7.text: Jehoshaphat tells the judges to judge for the LORD

2CH.19.8-9.text: Jehoshaphat appoints Levites and priests as judges

2CH.19.10-10.text: Judges must warn people to avoid guilt before the LORD

2CH.19.11-11.text: Jehoshaphat names leaders over the judges

2CH.20.1-2.text: Men tell Jehoshaphat that a vast army is coming

2CH.20.3-4.text: Jehoshaphat calls Judah to fast and seek the LORD

2CH.20.5-7.text: Jehoshaphat prays to God who rules all the nations

2CH.20.8-9.text: Jehoshaphat says Israel built a temple for God’s Name

2CH.20.10-11.text: Jehoshaphat tells God how enemies repay Israel

2CH.20.12-13.text: Jehoshaphat says Judah is powerless and looks to God

2CH.20.14-15.text: Jahaziel tells Judah not to fear, for the battle is God’s

2CH.20.16-17.text: Jahaziel tells Judah to stand firm and see God save

2CH.20.18-19.text: Judah bows down to worship, and Levites praise the LORD

2CH.20.20-21.text: Jehoshaphat urges Judah to believe and appoints singers

2CH.20.22-23.text: The LORD makes Judah’s enemies destroy one another

2CH.20.24-24.text: Judah finds only dead bodies of the enemy army

2CH.20.25-25.text: Jehoshaphat and the people gather plunder for three days

2CH.20.26-26.text: The people bless the LORD in the Valley of Beracah

2CH.20.27-28.text: Judah returns joyfully to the temple in Jerusalem

2CH.20.29-30.text: Other kingdoms fear God, and Judah has peace

2CH.20.31-33.text: Jehoshaphat reigns well, but the high places remain

2CH.20.34-34.text: Jehoshaphat’s other acts are written in the records

2CH.21.1-3.text: Jehoshaphat dies and his son Jehoram becomes king

2CH.21.4-5.text: Jehoram kills his brothers and some princes

2CH.21.6-7.text: Jehoram does evil, but the LORD keeps his promise to David

2CH.21.8-10.text: Edom and Libnah rebel because Jehoram left the LORD

2CH.21.11-11.text: Jehoram built high places and led Judah astray

2CH.21.16-17.text: Philistines and Arabs attack Judah and take Jehoram’s sons

2CH.21.18-20.text: Jehoram dies of a painful disease and no one mourns

2CH.22.1-3.text: Ahaziah becomes king and follows Ahab’s family in evil

2CH.22.4-5.text: Ahaziah does evil and joins Joram in war against Aram

2CH.22.6-6.text: Ahaziah visits wounded Joram at Jezreel

2CH.22.7-7.text: God brings Ahaziah’s downfall when he meets Jehu

2CH.22.8-8.text: Jehu kills the rulers of Judah and Ahaziah’s relatives

2CH.22.9-9.text: Jehu captures and kills Ahaziah in Samaria

2CH.23.1-3.text: Jehoiada makes a covenant to crown the king’s son

2CH.23.4-5.text: Jehoiada tells priests and Levites where to stand guard

2CH.23.6-7.text: Only priests and serving Levites may enter the temple

2CH.23.8-9.text: The Levites obey Jehoiada, who hands out David’s weapons

2CH.23.10-11.text: Jehoiada crowns Joash and anoints him as king

2CH.23.12-13.text: Athaliah sees the crowned king and screams treason

2CH.23.14-15.text: Athaliah is put to death at the Horse Gate

2CH.23.16-17.text: The people make a covenant and tear down Baal’s temple

2CH.23.18-19.text: Jehoiada appoints priests and gatekeepers for the temple

2CH.23.20-21.text: Joash is seated on the throne and the city is quiet

2CH.24.1-3.text: Joash becomes king and does right while Jehoiada lives

2CH.24.4-5.text: Joash orders money collected to repair the temple

2CH.24.6-7.text: Joash asks Jehoiada why the Levites did not bring the tax

2CH.24.8-10.text: The people bring the temple tax and fill a chest

2CH.24.11-12.text: Money from the chest pays workers to repair the temple

2CH.24.13-14.text: The workers restore the temple and make sacred articles

2CH.24.17-19.text: After Jehoiada dies, Judah’s leaders turn to idols

2CH.24.20-22.text: Joash kills Zechariah, who warned the people

2CH.24.23-24.text: Aram’s small army defeats Judah and punishes Joash

2CH.24.25-26.text: Joash’s servants kill him for killing Jehoiada’s son

2CH.24.27-27.text: Amaziah becomes king after his father Joash

2CH.25.1-2.text: Amaziah becomes king and does right, but not fully

2CH.25.3-4.text: Amaziah kills his father’s killers, not the killers’ sons

2CH.25.5-6.text: Amaziah gathers an army and hires soldiers from Israel

2CH.25.7-8.text: A man of God tells Amaziah not to use Israel’s army

2CH.25.9-10.text: Amaziah sends Israel’s troops home, and Ephraim is angry

2CH.25.11-12.text: Amaziah defeats the men of Seir in the Valley of Salt

2CH.25.13-13.text: Troops Amaziah sent away raid the cities of Judah

2CH.25.14-15.text: Amaziah worships the gods of Seir and a prophet warns him

2CH.25.16-16.text: Amaziah tells the prophet to stop; the prophet warns of ruin

2CH.25.17-17.text: Amaziah challenges King Jehoash of Israel to meet him

2CH.25.18-19.text: Jehoash answers Amaziah with a story and warns him

2CH.25.20-22.text: Amaziah will not listen, and Israel defeats Judah

2CH.25.23-24.text: Jehoash captures Amaziah and takes treasure from Jerusalem

2CH.25.25-26.text: Amaziah lives fifteen years after Jehoash dies

2CH.25.27-28.text: Men kill Amaziah at Lachish and bury him in Judah

2CH.26.1-3.text: The people make Uzziah king of Judah at age sixteen

2CH.26.4-5.text: Uzziah seeks God and God gives him success

2CH.26.6-8.text: Uzziah defeats the Philistines and other enemies with God’s help

2CH.26.9-10.text: Uzziah builds towers and develops farmland

2CH.26.11-13.text: Uzziah has a large, well-trained army

2CH.26.14-15.text: Uzziah equips his army and makes war machines

2CH.26.16-18.text: Proud Uzziah burns incense in the temple and priests oppose him

2CH.26.19-20.text: Uzziah rages at the priests and gets leprosy

2CH.26.21-21.text: Uzziah lives apart with leprosy and Jotham governs

2CH.26.22-23.text: Uzziah dies and his son Jotham becomes king

2CH.27.1-2.text: Jotham begins to reign and does what is right

2CH.27.3-4.text: Jotham builds a gate, a wall, cities and towers

2CH.27.5-5.text: Jotham defeats the Ammonites and they pay him tribute

2CH.27.6-7.text: Jotham grows powerful because he follows God

2CH.27.8-9.text: Jotham dies and his son Ahaz becomes king

2CH.28.1-2.text: Ahaz does evil and makes images of the Baals

2CH.28.3-4.text: Ahaz sacrifices his sons and worships at high places

2CH.28.5-6.text: Aram and Israel defeat Ahaz and kill many in Judah

2CH.28.7-8.text: Israelites kill royal men and take captives from Judah

2CH.28.9-11.text: The prophet Oded tells Israel’s army to free the captives

2CH.28.12-13.text: Ephraim’s leaders tell the army not to bring captives in

2CH.28.14-15.text: Men care for the captives and take them to Jericho

2CH.28.16-18.text: Ahaz asks Assyria for help as enemies attack Judah

2CH.28.19-21.text: The Lord humbles Judah and Assyria does not help Ahaz

2CH.28.22-23.text: In trouble, Ahaz sacrifices to the gods of Damascus

2CH.28.24-25.text: Ahaz closes the temple and builds altars to other gods

2CH.28.26-27.text: Ahaz dies and his son Hezekiah becomes king

2CH.29.1-2.text: Hezekiah becomes king and does what is right

2CH.29.3-5.text: Hezekiah tells the Levites to cleanse the temple

2CH.29.6-7.text: Hezekiah says Judah’s fathers turned away from God

2CH.29.8-9.text: Hezekiah says God’s anger fell on Judah for sin

2CH.29.10-11.text: Hezekiah plans a covenant and urges the Levites to serve

2CH.29.12-14.text: Levite leaders from many families begin the work

2CH.29.15-17.text: Priests and Levites cleanse the temple in sixteen days

2CH.29.18-19.text: The Levites report to Hezekiah that the temple is clean

2CH.29.20-21.text: Hezekiah offers sin offerings for the kingdom and temple

2CH.29.22-24.text: Priests sacrifice animals and sprinkle blood on the altar

2CH.29.25-26.text: Hezekiah stations Levites with music as David commanded

2CH.29.27-28.text: Singing and trumpets begin with the burnt offering

2CH.29.29-30.text: The king and the people bow down and praise God

2CH.29.31-31.text: The assembly brings sacrifices and thank offerings

2CH.29.32-33.text: The assembly brings many animals for offerings

2CH.29.34-34.text: Levites help the priests skin the burnt offerings

2CH.29.35-36.text: Temple service is restored and the people rejoice

2CH.30.1-3.text: Hezekiah invites all Israel to keep the Passover

2CH.30.4-5.text: The people agree to call everyone to the Passover

2CH.30.6-6.text: Couriers bring the king’s call to return to the LORD

2CH.30.7-9.text: The letter urges Israel to submit to the LORD

2CH.30.10-12.text: Many people mock the couriers, but some come

2CH.30.13-15.text: A great crowd removes altars and keeps the Passover

2CH.30.16-17.text: Levites slaughter lambs for people who are unclean

2CH.30.18-20.text: Hezekiah prays for the unclean people and God heals

2CH.30.21-22.text: Israel celebrates seven days with joy and praise

2CH.30.23-24.text: The assembly keeps seven more days with gifts of animals

2CH.30.25-27.text: Great joy in Jerusalem, and God hears the priests’ prayer

2CH.31.1-1.text: The Israelites destroy idols and altars in the land

2CH.31.2-2.text: Hezekiah organizes the priests and Levites for service

2CH.31.3-3.text: Hezekiah gives from his own goods for the offerings

2CH.31.4-5.text: Hezekiah orders the people to support priests and Levites

2CH.31.6-8.text: The people bring tithes and Hezekiah blesses the LORD

2CH.31.9-10.text: Azariah tells Hezekiah there is plenty left over

2CH.31.11-13.text: Hezekiah appoints overseers for the storerooms

2CH.31.14-15.text: Kore and his helpers give portions to the priests

2CH.31.16-16.text: Portions are given to males aged three years or older

2CH.31.17-19.text: Portions go to every priest and Levite in the lists

2CH.31.20-21.text: Hezekiah does what is good and prospers

2CH.32.2-4.text: Hezekiah and his leaders stop the water of the springs

2CH.32.5-5.text: Hezekiah rebuilds the wall and makes weapons

2CH.32.6-8.text: Hezekiah encourages the people not to be afraid

2CH.32.9-10.text: Sennacherib sends a message to Hezekiah and the people

2CH.32.11-12.text: Sennacherib says Hezekiah is misleading the people

2CH.32.13-15.text: Sennacherib says no god has saved a people from him

2CH.32.16-17.text: Sennacherib mocks the LORD in speech and letters

2CH.32.18-19.text: The Assyrians shout in Hebrew to frighten Jerusalem

2CH.32.20-21.text: God sends an angel after Hezekiah and Isaiah pray

2CH.32.22-23.text: The LORD saves Jerusalem and gives rest on every side

2CH.32.24-26.text: Hezekiah becomes ill, prays, and later humbles himself

2CH.32.27-29.text: Hezekiah has great wealth and builds storehouses

2CH.32.30-31.text: Hezekiah channels the Gihon water and God tests him

2CH.33.1-3.text: Manasseh becomes king and does evil like the nations

2CH.33.4-6.text: Manasseh builds altars to other gods in the LORD’s house

2CH.33.7-9.text: Manasseh sets an idol in God’s house and misleads Judah

2CH.33.10-11.text: Manasseh does not listen, so Assyria takes him to Babylon

2CH.33.12-13.text: Manasseh humbles himself and the LORD brings him back

2CH.33.14-15.text: Manasseh builds a wall and removes the foreign gods

2CH.33.16-17.text: Manasseh restores the altar and urges Judah to serve God

2CH.33.18-20.text: Manasseh’s deeds are written down and he dies

2CH.33.21-23.text: Amon becomes king and does evil like Manasseh

2CH.33.24-25.text: Amon’s servants kill him and the people make Josiah king

2CH.34.3-3.text: Josiah seeks God and begins to remove idols from Judah

2CH.34.4-5.text: Josiah destroys the altars and idols and cleanses Judah

2CH.34.6-7.text: Josiah destroys altars and idols throughout Israel

2CH.34.8-9.text: Josiah’s men give Hilkiah the collected money

2CH.34.10-11.text: Workers receive money to buy stone and timber

2CH.34.12-13.text: The men work faithfully under Levite overseers

2CH.34.14-16.text: Shaphan brings the found book to King Josiah

2CH.34.17-19.text: Shaphan reads the book and Josiah tears his clothes

2CH.34.20-21.text: Josiah sends men to ask the LORD about the book

2CH.34.22-22.text: The king’s men go to the prophet Huldah

2CH.34.23-25.text: Huldah says God will bring disaster on Judah

2CH.34.26-28.text: Huldah tells Josiah he will die in peace

2CH.34.29-30.text: Josiah reads the Book of the Covenant to all the people

2CH.34.31-32.text: Josiah and the people promise to follow the LORD

2CH.34.33-33.text: Josiah removes evil things and makes Israel serve the LORD

2CH.35.1-2.text: Josiah keeps the Passover and encourages the priests

2CH.35.3-4.text: Josiah tells the Levites to put the ark in the temple

2CH.35.5-6.text: Josiah tells the Levites to prepare the Passover lambs

2CH.35.7-9.text: Josiah and his officials give animals for the Passover

2CH.35.10-12.text: The priests and Levites prepare the Passover offerings

2CH.35.13-14.text: The Levites cook the offerings for everyone

2CH.35.15-15.text: Singers and gatekeepers stay at work during the Passover

2CH.35.16-17.text: The Israelites keep the Passover and Unleavened Bread

2CH.35.18-19.text: No Passover like this had been kept since Samuel

2CH.35.20-21.text: Neco warns Josiah to stop opposing God

2CH.35.22-22.text: Josiah does not listen and goes to fight Neco

2CH.35.23-24.text: Archers wound Josiah, and he dies in Jerusalem

2CH.36.1-2.text: The people make Jehoahaz king after Josiah

2CH.36.3-4.text: Neco removes Jehoahaz and makes Jehoiakim king

2CH.36.5-7.text: Jehoiakim does evil and Nebuchadnezzar takes him to Babylon

2CH.36.11-12.text: Zedekiah does not humble himself before Jeremiah

2CH.36.13-14.text: Zedekiah rebels and the leaders defile the temple

2CH.36.15-16.text: God sends messengers, but the people mock the prophets

2CH.36.17-17.text: God brings the king of the Chaldeans against Judah

2CH.36.18-19.text: The Chaldeans take the treasures and burn the temple

2CH.36.20-21.text: Survivors go to Babylon and the land rests seventy years
